name: lookup_form
description: Gives the title of a tax form, such as "U.S. Individual Income Tax Return" for 1040. Call it only when a question asks what a form is, and the note does not say it. It reads a table of titles. It writes nothing.

form_number.description: The number of the form as the note writes it, without the word Form, such as "5329", "1120-S" or "W-2".
